label: The preseason vibes ballot
basis: Editorial opinion · frozen before conference play
note: A subjective preseason finishing-order pick, not game standings or a schedule simulation. Projected conference records assume nine league games. Tied records are separated by editorial preference, not a predicted tiebreaker.

teams.name: BYU
teams.reason: Martin gives the offense a dependable center of gravity. Bachmeier supplies the upside. Our pick to handle the ordinary Saturdays well enough to survive one extraordinary one.

teams.name: Texas Tech
teams.reason: The obvious challenger: a program that feels built to turn a good drive into a scoring avalanche. Our bet is that the ceiling wins out more often than the volatility costs it.

teams.name: Utah
teams.reason: Dampier gives the Utes a way out when a play breaks down. We see a title-level ceiling, with a November road stretch keeping them just outside the top two.

teams.name: Kansas State
teams.reason: Trust the steady team in a league full of mood swings. We like the floor, even if the top-end fireworks belong elsewhere.

teams.name: Arizona State
teams.reason: The dangerous contender nobody wants to catch on its best night. A couple of coin-flip losses keep this pick below the title-game line.

teams.name: TCU
teams.reason: A team we can talk ourselves into beating anyone and losing a game it should own. Five conference wins feels like the middle of that argument.

teams.name: Iowa State
teams.reason: Ames still feels like the place a contender goes to have an uncomfortable Saturday. Our projection gives that edge more credit than star power.

teams.name: Houston
teams.reason: The dynasty poll has Houston at No. 21. We buy a real step forward, but want to see the week-to-week version before picking a title run.

teams.name: Baylor
teams.reason: Enough offensive possibility to spoil a season; enough questions to make the middle of the table feel right.

teams.name: Kansas
teams.reason: We expect points, nerve and at least one result that makes the whole league redraw its assumptions. Consistency is the remaining question.

teams.name: Arizona
teams.reason: There is upset energy here. We are less certain that it lasts across an entire conference schedule.

teams.name: Colorado
teams.reason: The headline potential is obvious. We are making the less glamorous bet: flashes of brilliance with too many uneven Saturdays.

teams.name: UCF
teams.reason: A team we expect to make visitors sweat. Turning that into a winning league record is the harder part.

teams.name: West Virginia
teams.reason: Morgantown will steal somebody’s clean afternoon. We do not yet see enough dependable weeks around that upset.

teams.name: Cincinnati
teams.reason: Competitive stretches, narrow margins and a couple of wins that matter. Our preseason instinct stops short of calling it a breakthrough.

teams.name: Oklahoma State
teams.reason: Our uncomfortable last-place pick. This is a vibes ballot, and the confidence comes with a very large invitation to prove us wrong.
